families.name: Observed production and participation
families.method: Aggregations, rates and exposure summaries
families.assessment: Retain measurements; remove unsupported interpretations.
families.limits: Observed production, age observations and appearance counts do not identify ability or medical injury risk.

families.name: Player profiles and similarity
families.method: Historical summaries, tracking summaries and career similarity
families.assessment: Retain as descriptive evidence.
families.limits: Similarity does not imply equal ability; participation proxies are not verified routes.

families.name: College translation and rookie evidence
families.method: Chronological college-to-NFL prediction and rookie history
families.assessment: Candidate foundation for development research.
families.limits: Draft selection, identity coverage and observed NFL entry limit generalization; not a validated general player-quality score.

families.name: Individual statistics and signal audit
families.method: Fixed comparisons of statistical feature families and derived metrics
families.assessment: Retain inventory and negative findings, not blanket usefulness labels.
families.limits: A failed feature in one fantasy model is not proof it has no football information.

families.name: Legacy V1 V2 and Adaptive boards
families.method: Legacy component projection, fitted and adaptive selectors
families.assessment: Compatibility and comparison layer. Named overrides, fixed age/depth multipliers and custom athletic scores retired; changed feature contracts require refitting.
families.limits: League-dependent targets and heuristics. Do not infer quality from fantasy ranks.

families.name: Preseason profile forecasts
families.method: Usage/prior references, ridge and histogram boosting
families.assessment: Keep as comparators; use release-scoped status.
families.limits: Production mixes skill, opportunity, availability and team context.

families.name: Current horizon rankings
families.method: Calibrated references, profile ridge and boosting, approved QB integration
families.assessment: Current application product; serving status is read from the selected release.
families.limits: References and promoted policies differ by position/horizon; no automatic transfer of approval.

families.name: Weekly references and ML challengers
families.method: Current/prior/blended references, ridge and histogram gradient boosting
families.assessment: Keep baseline and candidate comparisons separate.
families.limits: No live injury model; fractional receiving-yard scoring differs from current ESPN league scoring.

families.name: QB passing efficiency and opportunity
families.method: Historical pooling, direct/conditional boosted trees and nested recipe selection
families.assessment: Useful efficiency/opportunity decomposition; check each current scope.
families.limits: YPA still reflects teammates, opponents and selection. Not context-independent QB talent.

families.name: QB fantasy bridge
families.method: Cross-fitted passing forecasts plus point/residual models
families.assessment: Current scoped integration; keep separate from passing ability.
families.limits: This target includes league rules, rushing and touchdown outcomes.

families.name: QB tree capacity study
families.method: Bounded tree-configuration search
families.assessment: No established broad replacement benefit in the tested capacity search.
families.limits: Do not convert isolated favorable outcomes into a general larger-model claim.

families.name: Role and workload transitions
families.method: Role probability and conditional workload; preseason role features
families.assessment: Retain as opportunity research.
families.limits: Role and workload are distinct from execution and medical availability.

families.name: RB usage residual correction
families.method: Usage ridge plus nested shrinkage of residual ridge corrections
families.assessment: Not advanced: uncertain selection gain and worse point MAE in the recorded experiment.
families.limits: Archive the failed claim, preserve its evidence; do not rerun unchanged as a new success.

families.name: Future player multi-output lab
families.method: Ridge, histogram trees, extra trees, SVR, kernels, MLP, PLS, interactions and hurdle models
families.assessment: Reusable research platform with multiple targets.
families.limits: Targets remain observed production/participation, not a learned general quality label.

families.name: Deep feature and ensemble library
families.method: XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, trees, neural/linear methods and chronological ensembles
families.assessment: Retain complementary models; simple blends are important controls.
families.limits: Published comparisons are dated; MSE gains do not imply MAE, selection or ability gains.

families.name: RB Exploratory Research — GPU component models
families.method: GPU boosting/forests, CPU controls and earlier-selected ensembles
families.assessment: Promising production research, not current app approval.
families.limits: Core PPR differs from league scoring; independently forecast components can violate constraints.

families.name: Reusable saved-model forecasts
families.method: Pinned estimator/preprocessing artifacts, explicit position and origin contracts
families.assessment: Retain as reusable model-loading contract; registered specs are inventoried below.
families.limits: Saved model does not mean published or current-week compatible. No cross-position reuse of weights.

families.name: RB representations and player clusters
families.method: PCA, SVD, random projections, k-means and Gaussian mixtures
families.assessment: Retain controlled comparisons; no universal representation winner.
families.limits: All-year descriptive cluster membership is not a forecast-time feature or permanent player type.

families.name: RB draft-capital extension
families.method: Append dated draft fields to fixed tree anchors
families.assessment: Separate controlled extension; not additive to original ensemble gains.
families.limits: Draft capital mixes selection, opportunity and scouting information.

families.name: RB rushing play context
families.method: Spatial/motion features and tree/distribution forecasts at handoff
families.assessment: Relevant starting point for context-aware execution research.
families.limits: Uses handoff information and partial historical data; no established pregame or causal talent transfer.

families.name: General representation experiments
families.method: Raw/filtered input trees, transformations, PCA and kernels
families.assessment: Keep evidence against indiscriminate feature gates.
families.limits: A fantasy forecasting experiment does not establish an ability representation.

families.name: Player signals and uncertainty components
families.method: Rate pooling, participation, role mixtures, calibration, distributions and team allocation
families.assessment: Component research with mixed/negative results and explicit reopening conditions.
families.limits: Context-adjusted causal ability and universal standalone player scores remain unestablished.

families.name: Availability and injury observations
families.method: Dated absence evidence, participation forecasts and descriptive injury-report analysis
families.assessment: Retain mechanism-specific observations.
families.limits: Scoring appearances are not medical injury labels; unknown status must stay unknown.

families.name: Team context and correlations
families.method: Observed team/player correlations and strength simulations
families.assessment: Context and decision diagnostics.
families.limits: Correlations are not attribution; league strength is not a player-quality model.

families.name: Market and league benchmarks
families.method: ESPN projections, ECR comparisons and timestamped forecast scoring
families.assessment: Retain dated benchmarks; distinguish market-informed models.
families.limits: No general market-edge claim; reconstructed comparisons are not prospective forecasts.

families.name: Earlier metric discovery and rich weekly research
families.method: Walk-forward feature discovery and weekly/route-history models
families.assessment: Historical candidate library, not automatic serving approval.
families.limits: Research-selected associations require new target-specific validation for ability use.

families.name: Separate player ability ratings
families.method: No validated general estimator selected
families.assessment: Agreed direction only; no general ability estimator selected.
families.limits: Team-context rankings remain separate. Ability dimensions, scaling and aggregation require explicit definitions; fantasy scores are not talent labels.

families.name: Opening Drive — campaign tree forecasts
families.method: Position-specific boosted trees, chronological baseline comparisons and earlier-selected ensembles
targets: TE receiving and occasional rushing production
families.assessment: Reusable campaign research; evaluation and artifact availability are separate from promotion.
families.limits: Production combines opportunity, availability and execution. Historical seasons are reused research evidence; independent stat forecasts need not reconcile with direct points.
